theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_blowUp_hypotheses
theorems.statement: ∀ (m k ℓ : ℕ), ℓ ≤ k → ∀ (U N : Set (Euclid (m + 1 + k))) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (m + 1 + ℓ) N → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → IsMinimizingIn T (U ∩ N) → T.support ⊆ U ∩ N → BoundaryVanishes T → (∀ K : Set (Euclid (m + 1 + k)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ Λ : ℝ, 0 ≤ Λ ∧ ∀ (y : Euclid (m + 1 + k)) (R : ℝ), closedBall y R ⊆ K → MonotoneOn (fun ρ : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (Λ * ρ) / ρ ^ (m + 1)) * T.massOn (ball y ρ)) (Ioo 0 R)) → ∀ (x : Euclid (m + 1 + k)) (xs : ℕ → Euclid (m + 1 + k)) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ j, 0 < lams j), x ∈ U → Tendsto xs atTop (𝓝 x) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ j, IsOpen (dilation (xs j) (lams j) '' U)) ∧ (∀ R : ℝ, ∀ᶠ j in atTop, closedBall (0 : Euclid (m + 1 + k)) R ⊆ dilation (xs j) (lams j) '' U) ∧ (∀ j, IsMinimizingIn (blowUp T (xs j) (lams j) (hlams j).ne') (dilation (xs j) (lams j) '' (U ∩ N))) ∧ (∀ j, (blowUp T (xs j) (lams j) (hlams j).ne').support ⊆ dilation (xs j) (lams j) '' (U ∩ N)) ∧ (∀ R : ℝ, ∃ c : ℝ≥0∞, c ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ᶠ j in atTop, (blowUp T (xs j) (lams j) (hlams j).ne').massOn (ball 0 R) ≤ c) ∧ (∀ j, (blowUp T (xs j) (lams j) (hlams j).ne').boundary = 0) ∧ ∀ G : ℝ, 0 < G → ∃ (πs : ℕ → Euclid (m + 1 + k) → Euclid (m + 1 + k)) (G' : ℝ), (∀ᶠ j in atTop, dilation (xs j) (lams j) '' (U ∩ N) ∩ ball 0 G = ∅ ∨ (ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (πs j) (ball 0 G) ∧ MapsTo (πs j) (ball 0 G) (dilation (xs j) (lams j) '' (U ∩ N) ∩ ball 0 G') ∧ ∀ y ∈ dilation (xs j) (lams j) '' (U ∩ N) ∩ ball 0 G, πs j y = y)) ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∀ᶠ j in atTop, dilation (xs j) (lams j) '' (U ∩ N) ∩ ball 0 G = ∅ ∨ ∀ y ∈ ball 0 G, ∀ z ∈ ball 0 G, ‖πs j y - πs j z‖ ≤ (1 + η) * ‖y - z‖
